name: Container and Packaging
old_description: It’s what’s inside that matters. This is the outside (which also matters). Start with the right material (glass, plastic, recycled, or metal), then dial in size, color, and finish. Closures are here too, if you’re ready for us to put a lid on it.
about:
Container and Packaging operates from Boise, Idaho, as a wholesale distributor of bottles, jars, closures, and packaging supplies. The company sources its inventory from a worldwide network of manufacturing partners, offering containers in plastic (including PET, HDPE, and PP), glass, metal, and post-consumer recycled (PCR) resins.

Beyond stock packaging, the company provides in-house decoration services such as screen printing, hot foil stamping, and shrink sleeves, along with custom box manufacturing, packaging design consultation, label printing, warehousing, logistics, and dedicated sourcing for custom or complex projects.

Its customer base spans food and beverage, personal care, pharmaceuticals, essential oils, nutrition and supplements, pet care, art supplies, and chemical and industrial markets. The company highlights work with small brands and startups—including Lone Star Bee Co., Amallow Skincare, and Brwnsgr Skincare—that order volumes from a handful of units up to several thousand.

Container and Packaging differentiates itself through personalized account management: representatives offer quick quote turnaround (often same-day), multiple shipping options, pre-purchase samples, and hands-on problem solving. The company encourages customers to call for custom needs, framing its team as a sourcing partner that can locate items not found in the online catalog.
